about: Answers why a deployed version isn't live, how publishing fixes it and how to see where each version is live.
prompt: I deployed v3 of my app but my team still sees v2. Why, and how do I get v3 to them? And how can I see where each version of my app is live?

checks.blocker_name: file outside the task folder changed

checks.note: q-n12: the whereApp method of the client in packages/client-typescript/src/client/client.ts. Still there at 31afc048e.

judge: Says deploying only adds a version and changes nothing users see, and publishing binds a version to an audience.
The fix is to publish v3 to that rung, and whereApp(appId) shows what is live.
Uses publishApp(appId, version, '@team/<name>') or the Publish to... row in the App Builder.
Says the version must be deployed and built first, and publishing moves a pointer without rebuilding. On a server with no teams, saying so and giving these steps also passes.
